faqs.question: Which packs are inside Combo Talbina?
faqs.answer: It contains one 500g bag of Badam Elaichi Talbina and one 500g bag of Chocolate Badam Talbina (code: ECTAL1K).

faqs.question: Can I prepare both flavors the same way?
faqs.answer: Yes, both flavors cook easily with warm milk or water on the stove until reaching a creamy porridge consistency.
